notes.title: Update on the Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey all! We are at the halfway point for the intended time for the release of the newest content for "The Starlit Oasis." I just wanted to let you know that things are coming along well, and the update should be available on October 16th barring any unforeseen complications.[/p]

notes.title: Starlit Oasis has hit 100 sales!!!
notes.content: [p]I've dreamed about publishing my own adult visual novel for years, and when I uploaded "The Starlit Oasis" to Steam, I wasn't sure what kind of reception it was going to get. But 100 sales in less than a week makes me so happy and proud that I can scarcely believe it! Thank you for your support, and I will continue working on this game to make it the best it can be <3[/p]
